scientific_integrity: Infinite conclusions are derived symbolically; finite tests are described as consistency checks. Classical arch factorization, Baum–Sweet definition and Fibonacci identities are credited.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns prefixes from index zero with \(b(0)=1\), not factors, arbitrary absent subsequences or circular universality. It has no independent external validation; earlier unindexed equivalent literature may exist.
title: Exact scattered-subsequence universality and Fibonacci growth of Baum–Sweet prefixes
